_doc.about: PTY daemon resource quota configuration. Copy to ~/.crab/desktop/daemon/quotas.json and adjust as needed. Missing keys fall back to defaults. Send SIGHUP to the daemon to reload without restart.
_doc.maxConcurrentSessions: Maximum number of live PTY sessions the daemon will hold at once. New spawn requests are refused with quota-exceeded:maxConcurrentSessions once this limit is reached. Default: 50.
_doc.maxMemoryMb: Maximum heap usage (MB) before new sessions are refused. Checked at spawn time via process.memoryUsage().heapUsed. Default: 1024.
_doc.maxSessionLifetimeHours: Positive values kill sessions older than this many hours. Use 0 to disable age-based killing. Default: 0.
